scope: Restore live SpeechAnalyzer partials from the former Tauri implementation. Linux protocol/GUI evidence only; Swift compilation and native Mac recognition remain unverified at capture time.

behavior.input: Analyzer capability advertises streaming; UInt32.max switches the existing helper from sentence requests to continuous raw 16 kHz float32 PCM. Persistent pull-based conversion preserves samples split across reads; EOF finalizes once.
behavior.auto: Opening detection and all queued original sentences finish first; the remaining retained PCM and pending VAD tail start the native stream at their original source offset. Manual Analyzer starts streaming immediately. Legacy Apple and file-evaluation defaults retain sentence mode.
behavior.display: Microphone and system previews are separate and transient, shown in the transcript or floating over the board. Only finals enter glossary processing, meeting storage and board requests. Capture/meeting switches and stop clear previews; stale finals cannot clear a newer capture preview.
behavior.validation: Native event ranges must be finite, nonnegative, ordered, nonoverlapping and bounded by supplied audio (100 ms tolerance). Repeated finalized ranges are ignored. Errors retain any valid final already received in the same batch.
behavior.stop: One five-second helper finalization window; EOF closes input. A final received before a later timeout is preserved. This is not a bound on total device shutdown.
behavior.limits: 30 seconds of original PCM are retained for final voiceprints and capture endpoints. Later text survives, but evicted audio can leave speaker/start timestamps unknown. Live final ASR compute time is null because computation overlaps capture.
behavior.metrics: Per-source nonempty partial counts, first/last receipt since capture preparation and bounded Rust-to-UI receipt stats. No acoustic-onset, last-spoken-sound or screen-presentation measurement.

audio_regular.model: installed Silero VAD and SenseVoice; CAM++ absent
